scope: Four user-supplied client photographs added first to the website homepage gallery and full portfolio, in attachment order. No Google photo uploads.
preservation: Original JPGs copied without alteration and verified with SHA-256. Generated studio derivatives were visually compared with the originals for identity, pose, haircut silhouette and beard/clothing details. Generative editing may reinterpret fine details; the website retains its digital-editing disclosure.
